name: @ai-atomic-workflow/graph-fidelity
description: Platform-seam signal discipline — single-line per-call discipline echo (identity pointer + progress, R1), resident prompt injection (PCL + five-scenario enumeration + jcodemunch entry, attached via the SDK attach seam), and PCL mark observability — delivered as one module for OMP (ExtensionAPI) and opencode (Plugin). Platform hook registration, delivery, and the R1 signal chain are SDK-owned (@ai-atomic-workflow/platform-hooks-sdk, ADR 0192/0193/0195): this package binds its handlers through the SDK and consumes the chain from the SDK barrel; PCL detection and resident prompt content stay consumer-side. R2 context management is ACTIVE via the additional module @ai-atomic-workflow/graph-fidelity-context (ADR 0186). Exposes the discipline-hint and ToolDeny contract types type-only via ./interfaces.
